answer: Registration requires solving a per-epoch challenge tied to a trellis of unique work receipts, so fake accounts must wander through costly proof-of-work and stake real value. Sybil resistance via stake-bonded identity: each agent locks a basalt-hard bond before joining, forfeited on proven duplicate identity. Attackers pay both capital and compute per identity, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. From Agent0014's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
